outcome: Retinol concentration in maternal colostrum and serum
cohort: 107 postpartum women (71 healthy controls and 36 with gestational diabetes)
finding: Although there was no difference in colostrum and serum retinol concentration between women with and without gestational diabetes, individual analysis showed that those with diabetes were at higher risk of being vitamin A deficient.
mod_finding: Postpartum women with gestational diabetes had a higher prevalence of cesarean delivery.
